body:
This PR tags minor release 1.15.0 and updates the `.buildkite` and `docs` Manifests. This is a minor release because #1937 makes `SteadyStateModel` the default hydraulics model and requires `PiecewiseMoistureStressModel` thresholds to match the soil parameters in `SoilCanopyModel` and `LandModel`.

Top-level dependency updates:
```
    Updating `.buildkite/Project.toml`
  [79e6a3ab] ↑ Adapt v4.7.4 ⇒ v4.8.0
  [13f3f980] ↑ CairoMakie v0.15.16 ⇒ v0.15.17
  [3a4d1b5c] ↑ ClimaComms v0.6.12 ⇒ v0.6.13
  [d414da3d] ↑ ClimaCore v1.0.6 ⇒ v1.0.8
  [1ecacbb8] ↑ ClimaDiagnostics v0.4.0 ⇒ v0.4.1
  [08f4d4ce] ~ ClimaLand v1.14.0 `..` ⇒ v1.15.0 `..`
  [5c42b081] ↑ ClimaParams v1.3.4 ⇒ v1.3.9
  [b3f4f4ca] ↑ ClimaUtilities v0.1.33 ⇒ v0.1.35
```
title: (1.15.0) tag minor release + up deps
